name: 12-zod-safe-codec-factories
title: Build safe encode/decode parsers once per error class
body: `_safeEncode`, `_safeDecode` and their async variants called `_safeParse(_Err)` / `_safeParseAsync(_Err)` on every invocation, allocating a new closure per call. They now create the underlying parser once, matching how `_encode`/`_decode` hoist `_parse(_Err)`; the decode variants simply return it since they add no behaviour.
